messages:
maria: Heads-up: VoltEdge asked for a focused perf/W + kernel-tune sweep for their compact SoC next Tue/Wed. Scope: int4 quantized llama-like model, seq512, steady-state throughput and power telemetry. They want both microkernel probes and end-to-end inference runs. Can infra + eng-runtime own the run and data format? @kevin @alex can you take point and propose run plan by EOD today?

kevin: Yep, can do. Quick notes: we have 4 test boards in rack-C that match their board IDs. Need firmware >= 1.2.1 (power telemetry fix) and kernel patch for prefetch alignment (I have a draft). I'll validate cooling profile.

alex: I pushed a harness image to gcr: gcr.io/redwood/bench-harness:voltedge-int4-v1 and synced the test vectors to s3://redwood-partners/voltedge/day0/. Basic smoke command:```bash
./run_bench --model llama-7b-int4 --seq 512 --concurrency 8 --iters 200 --telemetry /tmp/tele.json
```Observed ~650 toks/s/board at concurrency=8 on early runs (no kernel patch). Will run a throughput sweep tonight and attach CSV.

nidhi: Observed issue in a quick CI run: batching at concurrency >= 16 causes a latency tail > 2s due to KV cache thrashing. For the sweep, recommend: 1) cap per-board concurrency at 12 2) enable prefix KV caching with ttl=30s 3) collect per-token latency histogram. Adding these to the runbook link: https://internal.redwood/bench/runbooks/voltedge-day0 (draft).

kevin: Kernel patch PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/kernel-patches/pull/312 — small change to prefetch window and cpuid checks. Patch reduces stalls in microbench. Test matrix: with patch vs without, int4 microkernels, seq 128/512, power sampling at 1s.

alex: Quick perf snippet (raw):```json
{"board":"C3","mode":"int4","seq":512,"concurrency":8,"toks_s":652.3,"pwr_w":78.5}
```I'll convert to CSV for the partner.

sam: I'll book a Dedicated canary on Wed 09:00-12:00 (PST) to validate routing/fallback behavior if one board drops. Also setting up automatic snapshotting of telemetry to s3 and a short retention (7d) for the partner trials.

oncall-bot: deploy-bot: smoke test for harness image passed in staging (build 2026-04-18-09). Logs: https://ci.redwood/builds/77412 :white_check_mark:

maria: Great progress :thumbsup: Action items summary:
- kevin: land firmware and coordinate with VoltEdge fw team for 1.2.1 rollout (owner)
- kevin/alex: validate kernel PR on 4 boards + post perf CSV by EOD tonight
- alex: run full throughput sweep (concurrency sweep 4/8/12) and attach aggregated CSV + per-token histograms
- nidhi: update runbook with batching guidance and latency histograms
- sam: schedule canary + ensure telemetry upload to s3

Please cc the VoltEdge contact (Jordan) in the final data bundle and include a short README describing the measurement methodology (sampling rate, power sensor calibration, thermal baseline). If we hit any weird tails, flag it in #eng-runtime immediately. Thanks everyone.
